description:
## Google Maps for ReVanced GmsCore

- Routes Google Maps navigation guidance to BYD vendor navigation stream 14 on supported BYD builds, while preserving the original audio behavior on non-BYD and unsupported devices.
- Adds inspected support for Google Maps `26.33.02.961351034` and retains `26.32.06.958047303`.
- Retains existing ReVanced GmsCore compatibility, package and permission rewrites, notification suppression, Timeline routing, Picture-in-Picture declaration, and original voice-search behavior.

Supported versions: `26.32.06.958047303`, `26.33.02.961351034`
